### Problem

The release lane cannot pass: a pull request whose description says nothing true about its diff is, rightly, never merged by policy, so no scenario that waits on a merge can pass.

### Scope

tests/release/scenarios.yml's `pull` body and the fields it reads, scripts/release-scenarios.py's writing of each scenario pull request's description and its check in `coverage`/`plan`, and their `--test`.

### Out of scope

The review's description check itself. The scenarios' expectations.

### Acceptance criteria

C1: Given any scenario of tests/release/scenarios.yml that opens a pull request, when release-scenarios.py writes its description, then it names each file the pull request adds, edits or removes.
C2: Given a scenario whose pull request's description would name no change, when `release-scenarios.py coverage` runs, then it fails and names the scenario.
C3: Given the description and the diff of a scenario pull request, when they are compared by `--test` on fixtures, then every file of the diff is named in the description.

### Criticality

Critical
